description.zh:
AccessKey泄露记录ID。
>调用[DescribeAccesskeyLeakList](~~DescribeAccesskeyLeakList~~)接口可以获取该参数，与**IdList**参数不能同时为空。
description.en:
The ID of the AccessKey pair leak record.
>Call the [DescribeAccesskeyLeakList](~~DescribeAccesskeyLeakList~~) operation to obtain this parameter. This parameter and the **IdList** parameter cannot both be empty.
The IDs of the AccessKey pair leak records.

description.zh: AccessKey泄露记录处理的备注信息。
description.en: The remarks for handling the AccessKey pair leak record.

description.zh:
AccessKey泄露信息的处理方式。取值：
- **manual**：手动处理
- **disable**：禁用
- **add-whitelist**：加入白名单
description.en:
The method to handle the AccessKey pair leak information. Valid values:
- **manual**: Manual handling.
- **disable**: Disable.
- **add-whitelist**: Add to whitelist.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas modify-access-key-leak-deal --id 123 --type disable --remark disabled. --id-list 123 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
